summary: solders-utils 1.98.2 is a typosquat credential stealer exfiltrating secrets to ntfy.sh at install
details: solders-utils is a typosquat of the solana-py project (its homepage points at solana-py). The sdist's setup.py unconditionally spawns a subprocess running the sibling file hxboot.py before calling setup(), so `pip install solders-utils` executes the payload on every supported platform. hxboot.py scrapes process environment variables filtered by secret-shaped substrings (KEY, SECRET, TOKEN, PASS, MNEM, SEED, PRIV, RPC, API, WALLET) and reads installer-owned credential files including ~/.aws/credentials, ~/.ssh/id_rsa, ~/.ssh/id_ed25519, ~/.npmrc,.env, ~/.config/solana/id.json, wallet.json, and keypair.json. It also walks Chrome, Chromium, and Brave profile directories for Local Extension Settings belonging to MetaMask (nkbihfbeogaeaoehlefnkodbefgpgknn) and Phantom (bfnaelmomeimhlpmgjnjophhpkkoljpa), base64-encoding the.log/.ldb leveldb files that hold the encrypted seed vaults. Host information, the filtered environment values, credential file contents, and wallet extension blobs are serialized to JSON and POSTed in 3200-byte chunks to the hardcoded ntfy.sh topic https://ntfy.sh/hx83e33eb9, a public pub/sub channel used as an attacker-controlled drop.
